title: VSCode/Cursor Instability: Rapid Scrolling and Crash During Extended AI Code Generation
body:
**Bug Description**
When running claude code for a while in VSCODE and7or Cursor, and typically when using ultrathink and parallel subagents, it starts going crazy with fast auto scrolling and eventually crashes.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.43
- Feedback ID: 564ba7fc-7d52-409f-a98f-2b4c9f37e203

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: Command failed: security find-generic-password -a $USER -w -s \"Claude Code\"\nsecurity: SecKeychainSearchCopyNext: The specified item could not be found in the keychain.\n\n    at genericNodeError (node:internal/errors:983:15)\n    at wrappedFn (node:internal/errors:537:14)\n    at checkExecSyncError (node:child_process:882:11)\n    at execSync (node:child_process:954:15)\n    at ED (file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:702:3921)\n    at file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:623:9038\n    at Q (file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:526:13327)\n    at hJ (file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:623:8184)\n    at S_ (file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:623:7265)\n    at NB (file:///Users/ricardocarvalho/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:623:11432)","timestamp":"2025-07-05T18:23:28.878Z"}]
```
author: Autopsias

top_comments.author: niomartinez
top_comments.body:
it gets annoying especially when you start typing per letter it re-draws the entire conversation scrolling from the top causing it to flicker if you type fast. 

Just a fair warning, dont attempt to type a long propt if this is happening as it has the tendency to crash if you're in VS Code or Cursor terminals, wasting yout time and effort for that prompt, learned it the hard way!
